inputs: Click View; collect the live accessible menu/row identities, labels, focus, enabled/sensitive states and unavailable reasons alongside the rendered menu.
Use Down/Up to visit Fit and Layer Visibility; record accessible focus/state after each key, then press Enter on the unavailable row.
Repeat row navigation/refusal for pointer-opened Help / About Datum and Window / Documents; press Escape and verify editor focus and F operability.
Change focused content Board to unresolved schematic and back through the existing pane controls; repeat View accessibility observations and confirm Fit availability changes with the rendered row.
Inspect that existing Terminal and Preferences accessibility objects are not replaced by menu objects; no setting change is made.

dispatches.unavailable_reason: Layer Visibility menu action is unavailable in this build.
About Datum is unavailable in this build.
Documents menu action is unavailable in this build.

actual_visible: Producer inspected native menu focus outlines, dimmed unavailable rows, resolved/unresolved Fit states, the separate Global Preferences window and restored View menu after its dismissal. Full reasons are available through live native descriptions and refusal history. This proves pointer-opened keyboard-row operation, not a fully keyboard-only application or Preferences acceptance.
actual_state: Live AT-SPI nodes retain stable menu identities and labels; focused/enabled/sensitive bits and descriptions agree with production readiness. Raw private-bus menu StateChanged and ChildrenChanged events are recorded. Dismissed menus leave no phantom nodes; existing Terminal and Preferences objects are retained. Escape restores Editor F, and no source/journal/settings write occurs.
